A_vs_B_translation_only.verdict: Translation within 3cm drastically reduces epipolar Sampson error on adjacent pairs, but has zero effect on single-source straightness and zero effect on rendered vertical P95.

A_vs_C_joint_rotation_translation.verdict: Joint rotation and translation yields marginal sub-pixel vertical improvement (0.07 px stitched, total 11.43% vs R4P3), remaining far below the required 25.0% threshold.

A_vs_D_seam_ownership.verdict: Graph-cut seam boundary placement reduces vertical edge error by 1.32 px overall, acting as the primary driver of rendered line quality.

governing_physical_insight: Camera baselines in the physical capture ring range from 4.3 cm to 30.5 cm, producing 30 to 956 px of optical parallax on nearby features (0.56m to 1.88m). Conservative translation (<= 3 cm) and rotation (<= 3 deg) bounds cannot eliminate this physical parallax. Furthermore, Camera 0 is strictly gauge-locked, fixing ROI_01 error at 11.45 px. Therefore, no conservative rigid geometry change can achieve the contractual 25% vertical improvement gate.
